lessonRef.subject: mathematics
lessonRef.title: Performance task build: qualitative graph interpretation

sections.title: Guided practice
sections.directions: Set up the first two carefully; the rest of the build depends on them.

items.prompt: A plant grows at a steady rate the entire time it is measured. Which description best matches the shape of the graph over time?
choices: increasing, then constant, then decreasing
increasing at a constant rate the whole time
constant, then increasing
decreasing at a constant rate the whole time

items.prompt:
A graph shows height over time.
From t = 0 to t = 2, height goes from 10 to 11.
From t = 2 to t = 7, height goes from 11 to 11.
From t = 7 to t = 8, height goes from 11 to 10.
Which interval shows the height constant?
choices: t = 2 to t = 7
t = 7 to t = 8
t = 0 to t = 2
No interval shows this behavior.

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: Consider the relation {(-10, 4), (9, -4), (2, 8), (2, 7)}. Is this relation a function?
choices: Yes, this relation is a function.
No, this relation is not a function.
Cannot be determined from the given pairs.
It is a function only if every output is different.

items.prompt: Which set of ordered pairs does NOT represent a function?
Given f(x) = -2x + 10, find the value of x for which f(x) = 16.

Function B is given by f(x) = 6x - 12. Function A is given by the table:
x: 3, 4
y: -34, -39
Which function has the greater rate of change?
choices: They have the same rate of change.
Function A
Function B
Cannot be determined from the given information.

items.prompt: Function B is given by f(x) = -3x - 3. Function A starts at 10 and decreases by 6 each unit. Which function has the greater value when x = 6?
choices: The two functions have equal values at that input.
Function A
Cannot be determined without a graph.
Function B

sections.title: Extension and challenge
sections.directions: Carry the build to a result and state the check that would catch an error in it.

items.prompt:
A table shows:
x: 1, 4, 7, 10
y: 3, -6, -15, -24
Is the relationship linear or nonlinear?
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.

items.prompt: Classify the equation y = -8x - 3 as linear or nonlinear.
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.
